name: copywriting-tools
description: Layer 1/2 — general-purpose writing components, usable standalone: two tone guides (tone-scientific, tone-conversational) for the author's registers, docx-build writes a Markdown-to-Word converter for one template out of shared modules, docx-verify proves the document is right by structure and by eye. excalidraw-export turns diagrams into PNG in the venue's font and warns when their text would print too small.
